name: Dr. Alice Johnson
goals: Quickly review aggregated feedback ratings and comments for her courses
Identify common themes in student feedback to adjust teaching methods
frustrations: Third-party survey tools that require logging in and navigating multiple screens
Difficulty obtaining a concise summary of student opinions without manual aggregation

name: Bob Smith
goals: Submit anonymous course feedback easily without creating an account
Provide detailed opinions on different aspects of the course
frustrations: Feedback forms that force account creation or have lengthy multi-page workflows
Lack of clarity on which aspects (e.g., Teaching, Pace) to evaluate
